title: The InfraRed Doppler instrument for the Subaru Telescope instrument description and commissioning results
what_was_studied: Fibre injection, cryogenic spectrograph, scrambler and laser-comb subsystems
numerical_result: Y J and H bands are covered simultaneously at resolving power up to about 70000; first light occurred in August 2017
remaining_question: Commissioning architecture is not an achieved long-term RV statistic

title: Precision radial velocity measurements by forward modelling in the near infrared
what_was_studied: Segment-wise instrumental-profile and telluric forward modelling for IRD spectra
numerical_result: Simulations showed below 2 m/s precision for slowly rotating mid-to-late M dwarfs above signal-to-noise 100 per pixel
remaining_question: Simulated precision and internal uncertainty are not a multi-year stable-star floor

title: Transit spectroscopy of K2-33b with Subaru IRD
what_was_studied: Time-resolved IRD spectra reduced with the forward model
numerical_result: Individual reported RV uncertainties in the displayed sequence varied from about 12 to 55 m/s
remaining_question: A rapidly rotating young star during transit is not a precision-standard test

title: PyIRD a Python-based data reduction pipeline for Subaru IRD and REACH
what_was_studied: Open Python reduction for detector correction, extraction and wavelength processing
numerical_result: The January 2026 record is a software preprint and does not by itself validate stellar RV accuracy
remaining_question: Cross-version agreement and injected-signal recovery remain to be measured on held-out nights
